088.t: Logic Gates: AND, OR and NOT
o: Recognise gate symbols and explain each gate.
Predict outputs for specified input values.
Use gates to represent everyday control rules.
c: Logic gates work with Boolean input and output values 0 and 1.
AND outputs 1 only if both inputs are 1. Its symbol has a flat input edge and rounded output edge.
OR outputs 1 if either or both inputs are 1; it outputs 0 only for 0,0.
NOT has one input and outputs the opposite value; its symbol has a small inversion bubble.

m.title: Model an AND alarm
m.q: An alarm sounds only if a door is open (A=1) AND the system is armed (B=1). Explain the outputs for A=1,B=1 and A=1,B=0. [4 marks]
st: This is an AND rule because both conditions must be true [1].
With 1,1 the output is 1 [1], so the alarm sounds.
With 1,0 the output is 0 [1] because both are not true [1].
Show each input pair alongside its output before revealing.

w: A buzzer sounds if either A or B is on. Give OR outputs for A,B = 00,01,10,11. [4 marks]
0,1,1,1 in the given order, one mark for each correct output.
A safety indicator is NOT A. Give output for A=0 and A=1. [2 marks]
For A=0 output 1 [1]; for A=1 output 0 [1].
A fan needs power A and permission B. Explain why AND is suitable and state outputs for 1,0 and 1,1. [4 marks]
Both inputs must be high [1], so AND is suitable [1]. 1 AND 0=0 [1]; 1 AND 1=1 [1].
wSteps: 0,1,1,1 in the given order, one mark for each correct output.
For A=0 output 1 [1]; for A=1 output 0 [1].
Use AND because both inputs are required.
Both inputs must be high [1], so AND is suitable [1]. 1 AND 0=0 [1]; 1 AND 1=1 [1].

k.q: Trace the alarm's AND condition, then change the inputs.
k.code:
armed = true
doorOpen = false
if armed AND doorOpen then
    print("Alarm")
else
    print("Quiet")
endif
p: With doorOpen false, replace AND with OR and predict.
k.a: Initially Quiet. When both are true, Alarm. With OR, true OR false is true, so Alarm.
